flows.title: Contract from a verified LOA: FD submit/approve, Agreement submit/approve, Amendment
flows.notes: Verified by Phase 1 run ct-fd-agreement_20261123-165421 (2026-11-23): LA260000000004216 → FD CT260000000002293 submitted+approved → agreement submitted+approved; amendment form filled only (script never submits). 2026-10-30 chain: LA260000000004032 → FD CT260000000002209 (KAT-040/041) → agreement (KAT-042/043) → amendment (KAT-045, 2026-11-02). Start after a Direct LOA flow that reached LA_VERIFIED, or give --input LA=…. DATA RULE (run ct-fd-agreement_20261123-162306): KAT-040 fills 2 payment schedules with month index 5 (Katalon defaults), so the LOA contract must span at least ~6 months; a DP-route LOA from a 1-month SQ (LA260000000004215, Nov-Dec 2026) fails at fromMonth_0. Use an LOA from a Direct LOA flow (e.g. dloa-oneoff-services).
